map.视空间、命名、注意、延迟回忆多域。: Multiple domains: visuospatial, naming, attention and delayed recall.
map.：12 项合计 22 分，教育年限≤12 加 1 后 23 分 <26：提示认知: : the 12 items total 22 points, plus 1 for education of 12 years or less gives 23, below 26: this suggests cognitive impairment and needs further assessment.
map.：合计 28 分：认知正常范围内。: : total 28 points: within the normal cognitive range.
map.通常 <26 提示异常；教育≤12 年加 1 分校正。: Usually below 26 suggests abnormality; add 1 point if education is 12 years or less.
map.满分 30，覆盖注意、执行、记忆、语言、视空间与定向。: Full marks 30, covering attention, execution, memory, language, visuospatial skills and orientation.
